div.p: What is this screen? The final record of what happened after you completed a customer task.

ul.li: Choose the actual outcome of the action.
Write what you did and how the customer responded.
Add one next step, date, and optional Odoo activity when follow-up remains.

div.p: Start here: Select the outcome and write a useful note. If more work is needed, add a specific next step and date. Do not close the task with a vague note such as “contacted customer”.

field.name: outcome_note
field.placeholder: What happened, and what did the customer say?

field.name: next_step
field.placeholder: Leave empty when no follow-up is needed

button.name: action_confirm
button.help: Complete the work item with the selected outcome and a factual note. If a next step is entered, set its date and optionally create an Odoo activity.
Close without completing the work item. The item remains open and no follow-up activity is created.
